citations.claim: cart position exceeds -2.4 m track limit at first violating step
cart already near limit and moving outward 6 steps earlier while pole stays upright

counterfactual.change: changed initial x from -0.31 to +0.5 with all else identical; cart no longer starts with outward velocity toward near end so drift does not reach track end in 301 steps

explanation: State-feedback controller prioritizes pole upright (theta stays ~-0.08 rad, margin ~0.72) over cart centering. Starting at x=-0.31 with v=-0.44 outward, it applies only small ~0.3-0.6 N force (far below 68.8 limit), letting cart velocity grow more negative to ~-1.37 m/s and drift monotonically to x=-2.41 beyond track. No pushes or noise involved.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.411 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart slides steadily to the left from step 298 to 301 while its pole remains nearly vertical. By step 301 the cart is at the far left edge of the track, indicating it has left the allowed 2.4 m range.
